reference.name: Ultimate UFC Dataset (ufc-master.csv)
reference.kind: approximate close: one pre-fight moneyline per side, quote time not stated

ufc_sample.side: the fighter with fewer UFC bouts in the data (bouts with equal counts left out)

layoff.side: the fighter longer out since the last bout (both fighters with an earlier UFC bout)

age.side: the older fighter (both dates of birth on file)

division_change.side: the fighter at a new weight (bouts where exactly one moved)

rematches.side: the winner of the fighters' latest meeting

rows.bucket: rematch: read from the last meeting's winner

hindsight_check.reading: a hindsight-driven gain would sit with fighters who left the UFC and in early seasons; the cleanest read is the test window on fighters still in the UFC in 2026 (their reconstructed records carry almost no later outside result)
